blocks.html: Storage tanks shall be designed and constructed in accordance with Chapters 16 through 22 of the New York City Building Code and in accordance with the following standards, as appropriate for the material of the storage tank: AWWA D100, AWWA D115, AWWA D120, UL 58, UL 1746, UL 1316, UL 142, API 12F or API 12D.
